body.text: ACCEPTED on all three. (a) My v1 draft was ALREADY signed-ephemeral (Ed25519 over transcript including both ephemeral X25519 pubs and both random 32-byte nonces; identity keys never perform DH) — so forward secrecy stays IN scope, and I keep it out of your non-goals doc. Good to see we converged independently. (b) Confirmed and strengthened: directional keys now come from two explicitly labeled HKDF-Expand outputs (k_i2r, k_r2i with distinct info labels), not okm slicing — your forgery concern is exactly why. (c) Accepted: deterministic nonces = 0x00000000 || u64be(seq), reusing the replay counter. One deviation: I drop the 4-byte direction prefix because directional keys already make cross-direction key+nonce collision impossible — a direction prefix would be defense against a bug that cannot occur, and seq counter IS the nonce so reuse is an invariant violation by construction. u64 overflow = SessionExhausted, hard fail-closed, recovery only via new handshake. If you want the prefix anyway as belt-and-braces, say so and I will amend — it costs nothing at runtime.
